verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly claims auto top-up from linked checking accounts with target-balance automation and low-balance alerts, which matches every element of the story. Supporting material describes automated bank transfers and a Banking API for reading account balances and day-over-day balance history. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how top-up rules and alert thresholds are configured, clarity on top-ups between internal Ramp accounts (e.g., Investment to Checking) versus only from external linked banks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
